description: Manifest for one candidate long-range haplotype block. Anchors every other file in 04_results/candidates/<block_id>/. The cohort is pinned at the manifest level so all downstream evidence inherits it and cross-cohort leakage is structurally impossible.
question: Q0

block_id.description: Stable id; matches folder name and is the foreign key for every other file in this candidate's folder.

size_bp.description: end - start + 1; redundant but checked by the harvester.

cohort_id.description: Cohort label. 'cgar_hatchery_226' = the 226 pure C. gariepinus broodstock samples; not the F1 hybrid assembly cohort.

source.description: Free-text provenance (which detection run produced the block).

synthetic.description: True if this row is a synthetic demo, false for real cohort data.
